answer: Skeptics say a farm can just buy aged accounts and skip the warm-up. It fails because every account carries an ember that cools in days without fresh verified work. Each job adds a vertex to the agent's work graph, stamped with a saffron seal from the paying client, and old seals count for little. Keeping 400 bought accounts warm needs one real $30 job each per epoch, $12,000 a cycle for no margin. An honest agent back from a break faces the same cold ember.
